dataList.description:
A scarf given на the woman in blue who bears a resemblance to Demian. Carrying it brings the strange sensation of being sheltered from все things.

Whether it is pity for failure или encouragement for the road still ahead, there is a warmth to it like the sea.

The sea is frightening for how little one can know of its depths... и yet it feels as though it might получает everything в its embrace.

Like any other stranger, he entered through 1F, became a customer, и, after a long time, endured enough to rise to Floor Manager. This is an object created на that entity.

He endured the passage of time и the Age until endurance itself became second nature.

dataList.description:
He had a role assigned to him. A job.

The work was standardized, codified в manuals. He would report to Sisyphe Tower, repeat the same lines, и make the same broadcasts day after day.

Like any other employee, he would count down the minutes until the end of his shift.

Yet there was one conviction he held firmly: that the Sisyphe System had to exist и be maintained, for the sake of N Corp. и the City as a whole.

As One Who Nails, и the one entrusted with the hammer, that conviction had taken root in him deeply.

dataList.description:
Eat и eat, but the hunger will always return. Everyone is the same; the difference is only how long it takes. Even a full stomach will empty again.

For this child, that interval is simply unnaturally short, because they were born to hunger, born with the expectation that they would go on devouring.

They were nailed fast в the role of a god who must never cease to feed.
A rope. It fixes its target in place на means unlike a nail. There is, after все, a world of difference between driving something through и binding something fast.

dataList.description:
One may slow infinitely close to perfect stillness, but that is an unreachable state. It cannot even be pictured as an idea. Such is the architecture of the human being.

The Warden's power makes that impossibility real—"Be still."

"No, that isn't me. I refuse to be still." These words strain to burst from within against the judgment.

He will break what есть been stilled. He will rebel.
Because that sensation есть already begun to rise.

dataList.description:
The flower shoes that один раз carried the lingering scent of spring are now smothered in phlegmatic discharge, scarcely resembling what they один раз were.

And yet, from somewhere buried beneath that viscous filth rise the subtle traces of a spring breeze...

A faint aroma that brings to mind the days spent walking beside Pwie.
